blocks.content:
Crust — Thin outer layer
Mantle — 35–2900 km
Core — 2900–6371 km
Moho — Crust/Mantle
Gutenberg — Mantle/Core

items: Moho discontinuity defines the boundary between the Crust and Mantle.
Gutenberg discontinuity marks the junction between the Mantle and Core.
Total depth of the Earth's core reaches 6371 km.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Crust is the thin outer layer of the Earth.
The Mantle spans from a depth of 35 km to 2900 km.
The Core lies deep within the Earth from 2900 km to 6371 km.
The Moho discontinuity separates the Crust from the Mantle.
The Gutenberg discontinuity separates the Mantle from the Core.
